doc.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Hearing the Count Basie band at the Blue Note
summary: Hearing Basie's band at Chicago's Blue Note was like riding a horse he could not control; he loved Basie's economy and Joe Williams.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: How about Count Basie, since you brought up the element of space, and drive and swing.

We used to go hear Count Basie’s band at the Blue Note. That also is like getting on a horse that you couldn’t control. All you had to do is just hold on, because you sit there in the Blue Note and that band would strike up, and Basie with those – he knew how to get the most out of the least – using the least, and rhythm. I loved Count Basie and his band. When he got Joe Williams, who’s from Chicago – right? – we all were like, yeah.
